question: ______ was the first goalkeeper to become the captain of an international hockey team.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shankar Lakshman.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shankar Lakshman** was the first goalkeeper to become the captain of an international hockey team. 
 
• He was an Indian hockey player from Mhow in present-day Indore.
 
• He was the goalkeeper of the Indian team in the 1956, 1960, and 1964 Olympics, which won two gold medals and one silver medal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Birendra Lakra **is an Indian professional field hockey player. 
 
• **Richard J. Allen **is an American television soap opera writer. 
 
• **Parattu Raveendran Sreejesh** is an Indian professional field hockey player who plays as a goalkeeper and former captain of the Indian national team.
